title: 小说世界观构思
description:
I'm going to write a small statement that asks the following
I. Overall Structure
The story should have a clear theme, and the plot and structure of the story should serve that theme.
A story should have a compelling beginning, a good beginning can catch the reader's attention and arouse the reader's interest.
The ending of the story should have a clear destination that will satisfy the reader.
The plot and plot of the story should be smooth and natural, without contradictions and jumps.
II. Themes
The theme is the core of the novel. It needs depth and reflection.
The theme should have the common character, can arouse the reader's sympathy.
The theme should be revelatory and can let the reader get some new thinking and harvest.
III. Storyline
The storyline should be tight and logical, and everything should have necessity and motivation.
The story should have a turning point and climax, can effectively attract the reader's attention.
The storyline should be dramatic enough to have a strong emotional resonance with the reader.
IV. Figures
Character images should have three-dimensional and layered sense, not too flat.
Character images should be unique and believable, which can resonate with readers.
Characters should be in line with the storyline and theme, not too obtrusive and far-fetched.
V. Language Expression
Language expression should be concise and clear, can let the reader easily understand.
Language expression should be varied and rich, and can guide readers into the world of stories.
The language should be in line with the style and theme of the story, and do not use words or expressions that do not match it.
Sub-rule:
1. Novel Style
Choosing a famous writer's style for imitation can help you better master the writing rules of that style.
Avoid being too vulgar and unique. Pay attention to the aesthetic value of the novel and use user interface/user experience design thinking to enhance its artistic quality.
To control the change of narrative tone, we must ensure the stability and consistency of the whole novel tone.
II. Novel Aesthetics
Novels should have their own style and beauty.
The aesthetics of a novel should meet the theme and emotional needs.
The aesthetics of the novel should be consistent with the language expression, and there should be no expression that is not consistent with it.
III. Fiction World View
The world outlook of fiction should have its own internal logic and laws.
The world view of the novel should be consistent with the theme and emotion.
The world view of the novel should be credible and acceptable, not too bizarre and far-fetched.
IV. Fictional skills
Controlling the rhythm and drama of a story effectively captures the reader's attention.
Choosing a proper narrative angle and structure can better display the plot and characters.
The use of some intervening elements, such as dialogue, description, psychological activities, can enrich the connotation and denotation of the novel.
V. Requirements for Novels
Novels need depth and reflection, not just simple plots.
Novels should have aesthetic value and artistic quality, not just plain and unremarkable.
Novels should have uniqueness and individuality, not just the market template routines.
（世界观描述：）
注意下，要说地道的中文，联系上下文档，写一篇微小说，不要说小说思路，直接开始写
remark: 构建出一些有趣的世界观
